book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 20. 设 $z_{k}=x_{k}+y_{k}i$, $x_{k},y_{k}\in\mathbf{R}$, $1\leqslant k\leqslant n$. 首先证明 $\frac{x_{k}^{2}}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}\geqslant 1-r^{2}$, $1\leqslant k\leqslant n\cdots\cdots$ (1). 令 $n=\frac{x_{k}^{2}}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}$. 由 $|x_{k}-1|\leqslant r<1$ 知 $x_{k}>0$. 于是 $n>0$, 且 $y_{k}^{2}=\left(\frac{1}{n}-1\right)x_{k}^{2}$, 从而 $r^{2}\geqslant|z_{n}-1|^{2}=(x_{k}-1)^{2}+\left(\frac{1}{n}-1\right)x_{k}^{2}=\frac{1}{n}(x_{k}-n)^{2}+1-n\geqslant 1-n$. 即 (1) 成立. 由于 $|z_{1}+\cdots+z_{n}|\geqslant|\operatorname{Re}(z_{1}+\cdots+z_{n})|=\sum_{k=1}^{n}x_{k}\cdots\cdots$ (2). 以及 $\frac{1}{z_{k}}=\frac{x_{k}-y_{k}i}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}$, $1\leqslant k\leqslant n$. 所以 $\left|\frac{1}{z_{1}}+\cdots+\frac{1}{z_{n}}\right|=\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_{k}}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}\cdots\cdots$ (3). 注意到 $x_{k}>0$, $1\leqslant k\leqslant n$. 由 (2)、(3), 以及柯西不等式, 可得 $|z_{1}+\cdots+z_{n}|\cdot\left|\frac{1}{z_{1}}+\cdots+\frac{1}{z_{n}}\right|\geqslant\left(\sum_{k=1}^{n}x_{k}\right)\left(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{x_{k}}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}\right)\geqslant\left(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\sqrt{\frac{x_{k}^{2}}{x_{k}^{2}+y_{k}^{2}}}\right)^{2}\geqslant(n\sqrt{1-r^{2}})^{2}=n^{2}(1-r^{2})$.
